```{=html}
<style>
.ar-page {
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0A0A0F 0%, #1a0e2e 40%, #2D1B4E 100%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    color: #F5E6E0;
    padding: 2rem 1rem 3rem;
}
.ar-header { text-align: center; max-width: 560px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
.ar-badge {
    display: inline-block; font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: #C9A87C;
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,124,0.3); padding: 0.35rem 1rem;
    border-radius: 50px; margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
}
.ar-header h1 {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 5vw, 2.8rem);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C9A87C, #F5E6E0, #C9A87C);
    -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-size: 200% auto;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}
.ar-header p { color: rgba(245,230,224,0.55); font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.7; }

/* Stage */
.ar-stage {
    position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 560px;
    border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 0 1px rgba(201,168,124,0.2);
    background: #0a0a12; aspect-ratio: 3/4;
}
#cam-video {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover; transform: scaleX(-1); display: none;
}
#book-overlay {
    position: absolute; top: 10%; right: 5%;
    width: clamp(90px, 22%, 160px); cursor: grab; user-select: none;
    touch-action: none; border-radius: 6px;
    box-shadow: -6px 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 0 1px rgba(201,168,124,0.2);
    display: none; z-index: 10;
}
#book-overlay:active { cursor: grabbing; }

/* Captured image — shown in place of video after capture */
#captured-view {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; display: none; flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 20;
    background: #0a0a12;
}
#captured-img {
    width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain;
}

/* Start overlay */
#start-overlay {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(10,10,15,0.97), rgba(45,27,78,0.97));
    text-align: center; padding: 2rem; z-index: 20;
}
#start-overlay h2 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 1.4rem; color: #F5E6E0; margin: 0; }
#start-overlay p { font-size: 0.85rem; color: rgba(245,230,224,0.5); max-width: 270px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

/* Resize handle */
.resize-hint {
    position: absolute; bottom: 8%; right: 6%; width: 22px; height: 22px;
    border-right: 2px solid rgba(201,168,124,0.6); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(201,168,124,0.6);
    border-radius: 0 0 4px 0; z-index: 11; cursor: se-resize; display: none;
}

/* Flash */
@keyframes ar-flash { 0%{opacity:0} 20%{opacity:.85} 100%{opacity:0} }
.ar-flash {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #fff; pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 30; animation: ar-flash 0.4s ease-out forwards; border-radius: 20px;
}

/* Buttons */
.ar-controls { display: flex; gap: 0.8rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 1rem; width: 100%; max-width: 560px; }
.ar-btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.85rem 1.8rem; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; border: none;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif; transition: all 0.3s;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.ar-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
.ar-btn-primary {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7A1B3D, #9B2B55);
    color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(122,27,61,0.4);
}
.ar-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(122,27,61,0.55); color: #fff; }
.ar-btn-gold {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C9A87C, #b8956a);
    color: #0A0A0F; box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(201,168,124,0.35);
    font-weight: 800;
}
.ar-btn-gold:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(201,168,124,0.5); color: #0A0A0F; }
.ar-btn-ghost {
    background: transparent; color: rgba(245,230,224,0.4);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); font-size: 0.82rem;
}
.ar-btn-ghost:hover { color: #F5E6E0; }

.ar-status {
    text-align: center; font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    color: rgba(201,168,124,0.6); margin-top: 0.6rem; min-height: 1.4em; line-height: 1.5;
}
.ar-tips {
    max-width: 560px; width: 100%; margin-top: 1.5rem;
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 0.8rem;
}
.ar-tip {
    background: rgba(45,27,78,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,124,0.07);
    border-radius: 12px; padding: 0.8rem 1rem; font-size: 0.76rem;
    color: rgba(245,230,224,0.45); line-height: 1.5;
}
.ar-tip strong { display: block; color: rgba(201,168,124,0.7); font-size: 0.68rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
.ar-back { text-align: center; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
.ar-back a { color: rgba(201,168,124,0.4); font-size: 0.82rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; }
.ar-back a:hover { color: #C9A87C; }
#snap-canvas { display: none; }

/* ===== LIGHT MODE ===== */
body.quarto-light .ar-page {
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, #F5E6E0 0%, #EDE0F3 40%, #f8f0fa 100%);
    color: #2a1a1a;
}

}

    -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}

    color: rgba(45,27,78,0.6);
}

}

    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,230,224,0.97), rgba(237,224,243,0.97));
}
body.quarto-light #start-overlay h2 {
    color: #2D1B4E;
}
body.quarto-light #start-overlay p {
    color: rgba(45,27,78,0.55);
}

    background: #f0e8e5;
}

    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #9B2B55, #C94070);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(155,43,85,0.25);
}

    box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(155,43,85,0.4);
}

    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #9B2B55, #7A1B3D);
    color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(122,27,61,0.25);
}
body.quarto-light .ar-btn-gold:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(122,27,61,0.4);
    color: #fff;
}

    color: rgba(45,27,78,0.45);
    border-color: rgba(45,27,78,0.12);
}
body.quarto-light .ar-btn-ghost:hover {
    color: #2D1B4E;
}
body.quarto-light .ar-status {
    color: rgba(122,27,61,0.6);
}
body.quarto-light .ar-tip {
    background: rgba(45,27,78,0.04);
    border-color: rgba(45,27,78,0.08);
    color: rgba(45,27,78,0.55);
}

}

</style>

<div class="ar-page">
  <div class="ar-header">
    <span class="ar-badge">✦ Expérience exclusive — AT The Beginning</span>
    <h1>Posez avec AT.</h1>
    <p>Une photo, un souvenir inoubliable.<br>Activez votre caméra, glissez le livre, et immortalisez ce moment.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="ar-stage" id="ar-stage">
    <div id="start-overlay">
      <div style="font-size:3rem;">✨</div>
      <h2>Votre photo avec AT vous attend</h2>
      <p>Activez la caméra, placez le livre où vous voulez, et capturez un souvenir que vous garderez.</p>
    </div>
    <video id="cam-video" autoplay playsinline muted></video>
    <img id="book-overlay" src="../images/couvertures/AT_couverture.PNG" alt="AT The Beginning" draggable="false">
    <div class="resize-hint" id="resize-handle"></div>
    <!-- Captured photo shown here after capture -->
    <div id="captured-view">
      <img id="captured-img" src="" alt="Votre photo AT">
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Camera controls -->
  <div class="ar-controls" id="camera-controls">
    <button class="ar-btn ar-btn-primary" id="start-btn" style="touch-action:manipulation;">✨ Activer la caméra</button>
    <button class="ar-btn ar-btn-primary" id="capture-btn" style="display:none; touch-action:manipulation;" onclick="capturePhoto()">📷 Capturer</button>
    <button class="ar-btn ar-btn-ghost" id="stop-btn" style="display:none;" onclick="stopCamera()">✕ Arrêter</button>
  </div>

  <!-- Download controls — shown only after capture -->
  <div class="ar-controls" id="download-controls" style="display:none;">
    <a id="download-link" class="ar-btn ar-btn-gold" href="#" download="AT-The-Beginning-pose.jpg">⬇ Enregistrer la photo</a>
    <button class="ar-btn ar-btn-ghost" onclick="resumeCamera()">↩ Reprendre</button>
  </div>

  <div class="ar-status" id="ar-status"></div>

  <div class="ar-tips" id="ar-tips">
    <div class="ar-tip"><strong>👆 Positionnez</strong>Glissez le livre là où vous le souhaitez — à côté de vous, dans vos mains !</div>
    <div class="ar-tip"><strong>↘ Redimensionnez</strong>Faites glisser le coin ↘ pour ajuster la taille du livre.</div>
    <div class="ar-tip"><strong>📸 Capturez</strong>Cliquez sur "Capturer" puis "Enregistrer" — votre photo est prête !</div>
  </div>

  <div class="ar-back"><a href="./at_the_beginning.html">← Retour à AT The Beginning</a></div>
</div>

<canvas id="snap-canvas"></canvas>

<script>
(function () {
  var video    = document.getElementById('cam-video');
  var book     = document.getElementById('book-overlay');
  var overlay  = document.getElementById('start-overlay');
  var startBtn = document.getElementById('start-btn');
  var captBtn  = document.getElementById('capture-btn');
  var stopBtn  = document.getElementById('stop-btn');
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('ar-status');
  var resizeH  = document.getElementById('resize-handle');
  var stage    = document.getElementById('ar-stage');
  var capturedView = document.getElementById('captured-view');
  var capturedImg  = document.getElementById('captured-img');
  var camCtrls  = document.getElementById('camera-controls');
  var dlCtrls   = document.getElementById('download-controls');
  var dlLink    = document.getElementById('download-link');
  var stream    = null;

  function setStatus(t) { statusEl.textContent = t; }

  // Start camera
  startBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    startBtn.disabled = true;
    startBtn.textContent = '…Chargement';
    setStatus('Connexion à la caméra…');
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      video: { facingMode: 'user', width: { ideal: 1280 }, height: { ideal: 1920 } },
      audio: false
    }).then(function (s) {
      stream = s;
      video.srcObject = s;
      video.play();
      overlay.style.display   = 'none';
      video.style.display     = 'block';
      book.style.display      = 'block';
      resizeH.style.display   = 'block';
      captBtn.style.display   = 'inline-flex';
      stopBtn.style.display   = 'inline-flex';
      startBtn.style.display  = 'none';
      setStatus('✦ Glissez le livre à côté de vous, puis capturez !');
    }).catch(function (err) {
      startBtn.disabled = false;
      startBtn.textContent = '✨ Activer la caméra';
      setStatus('⚠ ' + (err.name === 'NotAllowedError' ? 'Autorisation refusée — vérifiez les permissions.' : err.message));
    });
  });

  // Stop camera
  window.stopCamera = function () {
    if (stream) { stream.getTracks().forEach(function (t) { t.stop(); }); stream = null; }
    video.style.display = book.style.display = resizeH.style.display = 'none';
    captBtn.style.display = stopBtn.style.display = 'none';
    startBtn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    startBtn.disabled = false; startBtn.textContent = '✨ Activer la caméra';
    overlay.style.display = 'flex'; setStatus('');
  };

  // Resume camera after reviewing photo
  window.resumeCamera = function () {
    capturedView.style.display = 'none';
    dlCtrls.style.display = 'none';
    camCtrls.style.display = 'flex';
    if (stream) {
      video.style.display  = 'block';
      book.style.display   = 'block';
      resizeH.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
      window.stopCamera();
    }
    setStatus('✦ Glissez le livre à côté de vous, puis capturez !');
  };

  // Capture
  window.capturePhoto = function () {
    var flash = document.createElement('div');
    flash.className = 'ar-flash';
    stage.appendChild(flash);
    setTimeout(function () { if (flash.parentNode) flash.parentNode.removeChild(flash); }, 500);

    var canvas = document.getElementById('snap-canvas');
    var dpr    = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 3);
    var sw = stage.offsetWidth;   // CSS stage width
    var sh = stage.offsetHeight;  // CSS stage height
    var nw = video.videoWidth  || sw;  // native video width
    var nh = video.videoHeight || sh;  // native video height

    // Canvas at stage size × DPR for sharp output without aspect ratio mismatch
    canvas.width  = sw * dpr;
    canvas.height = sh * dpr;
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

    // Replicate object-fit:cover + mirror (scaleX(-1)) in canvas
    // cover scale = the scale that makes the video fill the stage
    var coverScale = Math.max(sw / nw, sh / nh);
    var dw = nw * coverScale;   // rendered video width (may exceed sw)
    var dh = nh * coverScale;   // rendered video height (may exceed sh)
    var dx = (sw - dw) / 2;     // horizontal offset (negative = cropped)
    var dy = (sh - dh) / 2;     // vertical offset   (negative = cropped)

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(sw, 0); ctx.scale(-1, 1);  // mirror
    ctx.drawImage(video, dx, dy, dw, dh);
    ctx.restore();

    // Draw book at its exact CSS-pixel position (no separate scale needed)
    var br = book.getBoundingClientRect();
    var sr = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
    try {
      ctx.drawImage(book,
        br.left - sr.left, br.top - sr.top,
        br.width, br.height);
    } catch(e) { console.warn(e); }

    // Reset DPR scale before export
    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);

    var dataUrl;
    try { dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.92); }
    catch(e) { setStatus('⚠ Erreur canvas : ' + e.message); return; }

    capturedImg.src = dataUrl;
    capturedView.style.display = 'flex';
    video.style.display = book.style.display = resizeH.style.display = 'none';
    dlLink.href = dataUrl;
    camCtrls.style.display = 'none';
    dlCtrls.style.display  = 'flex';
    setStatus('✦ Votre photo est prête ! Appuyez sur "Enregistrer" pour la sauvegarder.');
  };

  // ── Drag (mouse + touch) ──────────────────────────────────────
  var dragging = false, dragOffX = 0, dragOffY = 0;
  function getPos(e) { return e.touches ? {x:e.touches[0].clientX,y:e.touches[0].clientY} : {x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY}; }

  book.addEventListener('mousedown',  startDrag);
  book.addEventListener('touchstart', startDrag, {passive:false});
  function startDrag(e) {
    if (e.target === resizeH) return;
    e.preventDefault(); dragging = true;
    var pos = getPos(e), r = book.getBoundingClientRect();
    dragOffX = pos.x - r.left; dragOffY = pos.y - r.top;
  }
  document.addEventListener('mousemove',  moveDrag);
  document.addEventListener('touchmove',  moveDrag, {passive:false});
  function moveDrag(e) {
    if (!dragging) return; e.preventDefault();
    var pos = getPos(e), sr = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
    var nx = Math.max(0, Math.min(pos.x - sr.left - dragOffX, sr.width  - book.offsetWidth));
    var ny = Math.max(0, Math.min(pos.y - sr.top  - dragOffY, sr.height - book.offsetHeight));
    book.style.left = nx+'px'; book.style.top = ny+'px';
    book.style.right = book.style.bottom = 'auto';
  }
  document.addEventListener('mouseup',  function(){dragging=false;});
  document.addEventListener('touchend', function(){dragging=false;});

  // ── Resize ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var resizing=false, resStartW=0, resStartX=0;
  resizeH.addEventListener('mousedown',  startResize);
  resizeH.addEventListener('touchstart', startResize, {passive:false});
  function startResize(e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); resizing=true; var pos=getPos(e); resStartW=book.offsetWidth; resStartX=pos.x; }
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', moveResize);
  document.addEventListener('touchmove', moveResize, {passive:false});
  function moveResize(e) {
    if (!resizing) return; e.preventDefault();
    var pos = getPos(e), newW = Math.max(60, Math.min(resStartW+(pos.x-resStartX), 280));
    book.style.width = newW+'px';
    var br=book.getBoundingClientRect(), sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();
    resizeH.style.left = (br.left-sr.left+newW-8)+'px';
    resizeH.style.top  = (br.top-sr.top+book.offsetHeight-8)+'px';
    resizeH.style.right = resizeH.style.bottom = 'auto';
  }
  document.addEventListener('mouseup',  function(){resizing=false;});
  document.addEventListener('touchend', function(){resizing=false;});
})();
</script>
```
